answer_1.quote: Our Text-to-Cypher task generation pipeline involves two main steps: 1) generating initial (question, Cypher) pairs with diverse graph patterns using templates, and 2) rewriting the questions to sound more natural using a LLM.

answer_2.quote: Execution accuracy, the standard metric in text-to-SQL evaluation, measures whether the results returned by the predicted query match those returned by the ground truth query ... We propose Provenance Subgraph Jaccard Similarity (PSJS) as an isolated measure of the subgraph matching performance.
